request.description:
Creates a new user account on the Rent Nest platform.

**Auth:** None required.

**Rate limit:** 20 requests per 15 minutes per IP.

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Full display name |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Must be unique |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Min 6 characters |
| `phone` | string | ✅ | Contact number |
| `avatar` | string | ❌ | URL to profile image |
| `role` | enum | ✅ | `TENANT` or `LANDLORD` |

**Success response (201):** Returns the newly created user object. The password is never returned. `status` defaults to `ACTIVE`.

**Errors:**
- `400 Bad Request` — validation failure (missing fields, invalid email format)
- `409 Conflict` — email is already registered

Authenticates a user with email and password.

**Auth:** None required.

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| `email` | string | ✅ |
| `password` | string | ✅ |

**Success response (201):** Returns `accessToken` and `refreshToken` as both JSON body fields and `HttpOnly` cookies (`SameSite=None; Secure`).

**Token lifetimes:**
- `accessToken` — 24 hours
- `refreshToken` — 7 days

All protected endpoints require the `accessToken` sent as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

**Admin credentials (seed data):**
```
email: admin@gmail.com
password: 123456
```

**Errors:**
- `401 Unauthorized` — wrong password
- `404 Not Found` — email not registered
- `403 Forbidden` — account is BLOCKED

Returns the full profile of the currently authenticated user.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (any role: TENANT, LANDLORD, ADMIN).

**How to authenticate:** Set the `Authorization` header to `Bearer <accessToken>` obtained from the Login endpoint. Alternatively, if cookies are enabled in your Postman environment, the `accessToken` cookie is sent automatically.

**Success response (200):** User object including `id`, `name`, `email`, `phone`, `avatar`, `role`, `status`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. The password hash is excluded.

**Errors:**
- `401 Unauthorized` — missing or expired token
- `403 Forbidden` — token is valid but account is BLOCKED

Returns a paginated list of all **available** rental property listings.

**Auth:** None — publicly accessible.

**Supported query parameters:**
| Param | Type | Example | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `page` | number | `?page=1` | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | number | `?limit=10` | Results per page (default: 10) |
| `city` | string | `?city=Dhaka` | Filter by city name |
| `minRent` | number | `?minRent=5000` | Minimum monthly rent |
| `maxRent` | number | `?maxRent=30000` | Maximum monthly rent |
| `bedrooms` | number | `?bedrooms=2` | Filter by bedroom count |
| `categoryId` | uuid | `?categoryId=...` | Filter by category |

**Success response (200):** Array of property objects with pagination meta (`page`, `limit`, `total`). Each property includes category info and landlord public profile.

Only AVAILABLE listings are returned. UNAVAILABLE listings are hidden.

Returns all property categories defined in the system.

**Auth:** None — publicly accessible.

**Success response (200):** Array of category objects. Each category has:
- `id` — UUID
- `name` — Category label (e.g., Apartment, Studio, Villa)
- `description` — Optional human-readable description

Use the `id` from this response as `categoryId` when creating a property or filtering the All Properties endpoint.

Fetches the full details of a single property listing by its UUID.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (LANDLORD role).

**Path param:** Replace the trailing `/` with the property UUID.
Example: `/api/v1/properties/565de813-8bfa-4491-bb2e-30c4b7dd0969`

**Success response (200):** Full property object including:
- Core fields: `title`, `description`, `address`, `city`, `monthlyRent`, `securityDeposit`, `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `amenities`, `images`
- `status` — `AVAILABLE` or `UNAVAILABLE`
- `category` — linked category object
- `landlord` — public landlord profile

**Errors:**
- `404 Not Found` — no property with that UUID exists

request.description:
Creates a new rental property listing owned by the authenticated Landlord.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (LANDLORD role only).

**Request body:**  
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |  
|-------|------|----------|-------|  
| `title` | string | ✅ | Short listing title |  
| `description` | string | ✅ | Detailed description |  
| `address` | string | ✅ | Street address |  
| `city` | string | ✅ | City name |  
| `monthlyRent` | number | ✅ | Monthly rent in BDT |  
| `securityDeposit` | number | ✅ | Security deposit amount |  
| `bedrooms` | number | ✅ | Number of bedrooms |  
| `bathrooms` | number | ✅ | Number of bathrooms |  
| `images` | string\[\] | ✅ | Array of image URLs |  
| `amenities` | string\[\] | ❌ | e.g. `["WiFi", "AC", "Parking"]` |  
| `categoryId` | uuid | ✅ | ID from the Categories endpoint |

**Success response (201):** Returns the newly created property object. Status defaults to `AVAILABLE`. The `landlordId` is set automatically from the authenticated user.

**Errors:**

- `400 Bad Request` — validation failure
    
- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not a LANDLORD
    
- `404 Not Found` — `categoryId` does not exist

Partially updates an existing property listing by its UUID.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (LANDLORD role). The caller must be the **owner** of this listing.

**Path param:** Property UUID in the URL.

**Request body:** All fields are optional. Only include the fields you want to change.
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `title` | string | |
| `description` | string | |
| `address` | string | |
| `city` | string | |
| `monthlyRent` | number | |
| `securityDeposit` | number | |
| `bedrooms` | number | |
| `bathrooms` | number | |
| `images` | string[] | Replaces existing image list |
| `amenities` | string[] | Replaces existing amenity list |
| `status` | enum | `AVAILABLE` or `UNAVAILABLE` |
| `categoryId` | uuid | |

**Success response (200):** The updated property object.

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — caller does not own this listing
- `404 Not Found` — property UUID not found

Permanently deletes a property listing by its UUID.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (LANDLORD role). The caller must be the **owner** of this listing.

**Path param:** Property UUID in the URL.

**Success response (200):** Confirmation message.

⚠️ **Irreversible.** All associated rental requests for this property will also be deleted.

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — caller does not own this listing
- `404 Not Found` — property UUID not found

Submits a new rental request for a property. Only Tenants may use this endpoint.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role only).

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `propertyId` | uuid | ✅ | UUID of the target property |
| `moveInDate` | ISO 8601 | ✅ | Requested move-in date/time |
| `message` | string | ❌ | Optional note to the landlord |

**Workflow:**
1. Tenant submits request → status is `PENDING`
2. Landlord reviews and sets status to `APPROVED` or `REJECTED`
3. If `APPROVED`, Tenant may proceed to payment
4. After successful payment, status becomes `ACTIVE`

**Success response (201):** The created rental request object.

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not a TENANT
- `404 Not Found` — property not found
- `409 Conflict` — Tenant already has a pending/active request for this property

Returns all rental requests submitted by the currently authenticated Tenant.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role only).

**Supported query parameters:**
| Param | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `status` | `?status=PENDING` | Filter by status: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `ACTIVE` |
| `page` | `?page=1` | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | `?limit=10` | Results per page (default: 10) |

**Success response (200):** Paginated array of rental request objects, each including the associated property summary and landlord details.

item.name: Get Rental Request Details By Id

request.description:
Fetches the complete details of a single rental request by its UUID.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role). The caller must own this rental request.

**Path param:** Rental request UUID in the URL.

**Success response (200):** Full rental request object including:
- `status` — current status (`PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `ACTIVE`)
- `moveInDate` — tenant's requested move-in date
- `message` — tenant's note to landlord
- `property` — full property details
- `payment` — linked payment record (if payment was initiated)

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — rental request belongs to another tenant
- `404 Not Found` — UUID not found

Returns all rental requests received across all of the Landlord's properties.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (LANDLORD role only). Only requests for properties owned by this landlord are returned.

**Supported query parameters:**
| Param | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `status` | `?status=PENDING` | Filter by status: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `ACTIVE` |
| `propertyId` | `?propertyId=...` | Filter to a specific property |
| `page` | `?page=1` | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | `?limit=10` | Results per page (default: 10) |

**Success response (200):** Paginated array of rental requests, each including the tenant's public profile and the associated property summary.

Allows a Landlord to approve or reject a pending rental request.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (LANDLORD role). The caller must own the property associated with this request.

**Path param:** Rental request UUID in the URL.

**Request body:**
```json
{ "status": "APPROVED" }
// or
{ "status": "REJECTED" }
```

**Business rules:**
- Only `PENDING` requests can be acted upon
- Setting to `APPROVED` enables the tenant to initiate payment
- Setting to `REJECTED` closes the request permanently

**Success response (200):** Updated rental request object.

**Errors:**
- `400 Bad Request` — request is not in PENDING status
- `403 Forbidden` — landlord does not own the associated property
- `404 Not Found` — rental request UUID not found

Initiates a Stripe Checkout payment session for an approved rental request.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role). The caller must be the tenant who owns this rental request.

**Request body:**  
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |  
|-------|------|----------|-------|  
| `rentalRequestId` | uuid | ✅ | UUID of an APPROVED rental request |  
| `successUrl` | string | ❌ | Redirect URL on payment success (defaults to localhost) |  
| `cancelUrl` | string | ❌ | Redirect URL on payment cancellation |

**What this does:**

1. Validates the rental request is APPROVED and belongs to the caller
    
2. Creates a PENDING payment record in the database
    
3. Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for `monthlyRent` amount
    
4. Returns the Stripe `checkoutUrl` — redirect the user to this URL to complete payment
    

**Success response (201):** `{ payment, checkoutUrl }` — open `checkoutUrl` in a browser.

**Errors:**

- `400 Bad Request` — rental is not APPROVED
    
- `403 Forbidden` — caller does not own this rental
    
- `404 Not Found` — rental request not found
    
- `409 Conflict` — payment already exists for this rental

Manually confirms a Stripe Checkout payment after the user has completed the checkout flow. This is a fallback for cases where the Stripe webhook did not fire.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role). The caller must be the tenant who initiated the payment.

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `transactionId` | string | ✅ | Stripe Checkout Session ID (e.g. `cs_test_...`) |

**What this does:**
1. Looks up the payment by `transactionId`
2. Calls Stripe to verify `payment_status === 'paid'`
3. Atomically updates the payment to `COMPLETED` and the rental request to `ACTIVE`

**Note:** Under normal flow, the Stripe webhook (`/api/v1/payments/webhook`) handles this automatically. Use this endpoint only if the webhook was missed.

**Success response (200):** The updated payment record.

**Errors:**
- `400 Bad Request` — payment is not PENDING, or Stripe reports it as unpaid
- `403 Forbidden` — caller does not own this payment
- `404 Not Found` — no payment found with that `transactionId`
- `409 Conflict` — payment was already processed (race condition guard)

Returns the authenticated tenant's full payment history on the platform.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role only).

**Supported query parameters:**
| Param | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `page` | `?page=1` | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | `?limit=10` | Results per page (default: 10) |

**Success response (200):** Paginated array of payment records. Each record includes:
- `status` — `PENDING`, `COMPLETED`, or `FAILED`
- `amount` — amount charged (property's `monthlyRent`)
- `method` — `CARD`
- `provider` — `STRIPE`
- `paidAt` — timestamp of successful payment (null for PENDING/FAILED)
- `rentalRequest` — linked rental request with property summary
- Pagination meta: `{ page, limit, total }`

Fetches the full details of a specific payment record by its UUID.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role). The caller must own this payment.

**Path param:** Payment UUID in the URL.

**Success response (200):** Full payment object including:
- All payment fields (`amount`, `status`, `method`, `provider`, `paidAt`, `transactionId`)
- `rentalRequest` with full property details (category, images, address)
- Landlord public profile (`name`, `email`, `phone`)

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — payment belongs to another tenant
- `404 Not Found` — UUID not found

Submits a review and star rating for a property. Only tenants with a completed (ACTIVE) rental for that property may leave a review.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (TENANT role only).

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `propertyId` | uuid | ✅ | UUID of the property being reviewed |
| `rating` | number | ✅ | Integer from 1 to 5 |
| `comment` | string | ❌ | Optional written review text |

**Success response (201):** The created review object.

**Errors:**
- `400 Bad Request` — rating out of range or validation failure
- `403 Forbidden` — tenant does not have an ACTIVE rental for this property
- `404 Not Found` — property not found
- `409 Conflict` — tenant has already reviewed this property

item.name: Get all reviews for a Property

request.description:
Returns all reviews submitted for a specific property.

**Auth:** None — publicly accessible.

**Path param:** Property UUID in the URL path: `/api/v1/reviews/property/`

**Success response (200):** Array of review objects. Each review includes:

- `rating` — 1–5 star score
    
- `comment` — written review text (may be null)
    
- `createdAt` — when the review was posted
    
- `tenant` — reviewer's public profile (`name`, `avatar`)
    

Also includes the aggregate `averageRating` for the property.

item.name: ADMIN

request.description:
Returns a high-level analytics summary for the admin dashboard.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (ADMIN role only).

**Success response (200):**  
| Field | Description |  
|-------|-------------|  
| `totalUsers` | All registered users |  
| `totalLandlords` | Users with LANDLORD role |  
| `totalTenants` | Users with TENANT role |  
| `totalProperties` | All property listings |  
| `availableProperties` | Listings currently AVAILABLE |  
| `totalRentals` | All rental requests ever submitted |  
| `pendingRentals` | Requests awaiting landlord decision |  
| `approvedRentals` | Landlord-approved requests |  
| `totalRevenue` | Sum of all COMPLETED payment amounts (USD) |

**Errors:**

- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not an ADMIN

variable.description: UUID of the user to moderate.

request.description:
Moderates a user account by updating its `status` field.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (ADMIN role only).

**Path param:** `id` — UUID of the target user.

**Request body:**
```json
{ "status": "BLOCKED" } // block the user
{ "status": "ACTIVE" }  // restore access
```

**Effects of BLOCKED status:**
- Login attempts return `403 Forbidden`
- Existing tokens are effectively invalidated (middleware checks status on every request)
- All public-facing actions (posting, requesting, paying) are rejected

**Success response (200):** Updated user object.

**Errors:**
- `400 Bad Request` — invalid status value
- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not an ADMIN
- `404 Not Found` — user UUID not found

request.description:
Returns all property listings across the platform, including UNAVAILABLE ones.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (ADMIN role only).

Unlike the public `/api/v1/properties` endpoint (which only returns AVAILABLE listings), this admin view includes all statuses and exposes full landlord details for oversight.

**Supported query parameters:**
| Param | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `status` | `?status=UNAVAILABLE` | Filter by listing status |
| `city` | `?city=Dhaka` | Filter by city |
| `page` | `?page=1` | Page number |
| `limit` | `?limit=20` | Results per page |

**Success response (200):** Paginated property array with full landlord info.

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not an ADMIN

Permanently removes any property listing from the platform by its UUID. This is a platform moderation action — it can target any listing regardless of landlord.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (ADMIN role only).

**Path param:** `id` — UUID of the property to delete.

**Success response (200):** Confirmation message.

⚠️ **This action is irreversible.** Unlike the landlord DELETE endpoint, there is no ownership check. Use with care.

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not an ADMIN
- `404 Not Found` — property UUID not found

request.description:
Returns all rental requests across the entire platform — from all tenants and all landlords.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token (ADMIN role only).

Unlike `/api/v1/landlord/requests` (scoped to one landlord's properties), this endpoint provides a complete unfiltered view.

**Supported query parameters:**
| Param | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `status` | `?status=PENDING` | Filter by status: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `ACTIVE` |
| `page` | `?page=1` | Page number |
| `limit` | `?limit=20` | Results per page |

**Success response (200):** Paginated array of rental request objects with tenant, property, and landlord details.

**Errors:**
- `403 Forbidden` — caller is not an ADMIN
